lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition As4N4O4 (reduced formula AsNO) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Cmcm (No. 63), with 12 atoms in the unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for all three elements: As centers have four neighbors (three N and one O), N centers have four As neighbors, and O centers have four As neighbors. The resulting neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between As and O tetrahedra, as well as between N and O tetrahedra.
